policy: Metadata/structural validation only: integer token IDs, 10-column row shape, MWT/empty IDs and sentence IDs. Never access FORM/LEMMA/UPOS/FEATS/HEAD/DEPREL fields or text comments; no model/graph/projection/evaluation. Roles fixed by README attribution and ID ranges, not outcomes. All Seneca and secure/attributed Dante labels reserved irrespective upstream train/dev/test. UDante Que/Egl/EpiXIII and ITTB mixedauthor concordances quarantined. LLCT supplemental genre not counted independent namedauthor. Existing PROIEL/Perseus inventoried only; their prior train/holdout reservations take precedence. No legacy heldout sentences or sealed raw works used as features.

upstream_policies.ittb: r2.17 README documented train sentence boundaries for SCG1–4; others quarantine
upstream_policies.udante: r2.17 README work/citation IDs and authorship caveats
upstream_policies.circse: r2.17 README and sent_id author/work prefixes

prior_exposure: Aquinas/Dante/Tacitus appear in older project experiments/raw corpora; reserve means new annotation/current applicability-model embargo, not globally unseen authors. Seneca is absent from current Cicero model, but no global raw-library novelty claim.
